observations: Photo 0: A large rectangular machine fully wrapped in green plastic/shrink wrap sitting on a pallet, marked with a handwritten '4' on the wrap, in an outdoor compound.
Photo 1: Same wrapped machine being moved by a hand pallet truck, with a person visible in the background near a doorway.
No nameplate, brand logo, model number, control panel, or any internal/mechanical component is visible in either photo.
No photo shows the machine unwrapped, powered on, or running a bottle-blowing cycle.

claims.claim: This is an automatic pet bottle blowing machine used in production to make pet plastic bottles
claims.evidence: Both photos show only a fully shrink-wrapped machine; no label, nameplate, or functional part confirms the machine type or its automation level.
No power-on, test run, or component photos provided.

risks.risk: Machine identity (brand/model/cavity count/capacity) cannot be confirmed, and these are the main price drivers for bottle blowing machines
risks.proof: Clear photo of the nameplate/data plate once unwrapped, showing brand, model, cavity number, and output capacity
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest-spec/unknown-model tier for this machine category

risks.risk: Functional/working condition unknown - machine could be non-working, missing parts, or for scrap/parts only
risks.proof: Video of the machine powered on and completing a blow-molding cycle with bottles produced

risks.risk: Completeness unknown - mold sets, heater bands, compressor, control electronics could be missing since machine is fully wrapped and unopened
risks.proof: Unwrapped photos showing all sides, mold station, control panel, and included accessories

risks.risk: Age/wear and prior usage hours cannot be assessed through wrapping
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame, molds, and wear points after unwrapping

proof_requests: Unwrap the machine and photograph the nameplate/data plate showing brand, model, and specifications
Provide a video of the machine running a full bottle-blowing cycle
Photograph all sides of the unwrapped machine including mold station, control panel, and compressor
Confirm what accessories/molds are included and photograph them
response.reason: The machine is entirely shrink-wrapped with no visible nameplate, model, or functional detail, so even a worst-case price cannot be set for an industrial machine whose value depends heavily on model, capacity, and working condition.
